[SWS_CM_10349] Making the Future ready
⌈
In order to make the Future returned
by the Set or Get method of the respective Field class (see [SWS_CM_00113] and
[SWS_CM_00112]) ready, the set_value operation (see [SWS_CORE_00345] and
[SWS_CORE_00346]) of the Promise corresponding to this Future shall be invoked
using the deserialized payload as an argument. This will unblock any blocking get,
wait, wait_for, and wait_until calls that have been performed on this Future.
⌋
